**Duration:** 20s

DescriptionEnhanced: Upon seeing the manmade wind-up Halone, Nald'thal was taken by a bout of mischievousness and decided to create an automaton of his own using a jewel buried in the earth. While the resultant product assumes the likeness of Oschon, unlike the deity upon whom it is based, it follows its master faithfully rather than wandering freely.

While the resultant product assumes the likeness of Oschon, unlike the deity upon whom it is based, it follows its master faithfully rather than wandering freely.

Description: Summon your oglop minion. Its unsettling gaze bespeaks intelligence...but surely it's only your imagination.
DescriptionEnhanced: The oglop is a variety of insect that has existed in the Ninth since ancient times. While considered a noxious pest in urban centers such as Everkeep, it is viewed with more leniency by folk in the countryside, who prize the rare oil that can be harvested from its glossy wings.
Tooltip:
You wouldn't believe the
trouble they can cause.
   - Uaauashe
SpecialActionDescription:
Increases caster ATK by 10 and DEF by 5 for every 5% of HP lost.
**Duration:** 6s

Description: Summon your wind-up Vincent. Hopefully not on the verge of committing another sin.
DescriptionEnhanced: Legends tell of a man who was subjected to dark experiments and given preternatural abilities. Upon awakening from his years-long slumber in a sealed coffin, he was haunted by his sins of the past, and chose to set forth on a journey of redemption─as his mammet likeness does now with you.
Tooltip:
His is an inspiring tale of redemption.
   - Makoto
SpecialActionDescription: Delivers an attack 5 times the potency of the caster's ATK.

Description: Summon your tiny omniscient minion. Knows a tiny little bit about all things.
DescriptionEnhanced: This diminutive, bearded entity was born of the Index, master of the Occult Crescent and self-proclaimed knower of all things. A loyal familiar to those it chooses to serve, it excels at keeping track of one's reading progress in a book, but a lack of depth in its knowledge makes it useful for little else.
Tooltip:
My uncle knows everything. So I do too!
   - Boisterous Boy
SpecialActionDescription:
Sets a trap that, when triggered, delivers an attack with a potency of 180 to all enemies within range.
**Activation Delay:** 10s

Description: Summon your puny mage minion. If you think it weak...you would be right.
DescriptionEnhanced: The puny mage was created with the goal of further miniaturizing a spellcasting mammet developed in the nation of Mhach during the twilight of the War of the Magi. While looking the part, its diminutive core means it cannot channel sufficient aether to wield magicks, and it ended up as simply a toy.
Tooltip:
Did the captain receive a blow
to the head while we were in Mhach?
   - Cait Sith
SpecialActionDescription: Removes all detrimental effects from all allies within range.

Description: Summon your wind-up Wuk Lamat minion. An adventurer like you could hardly resist, no?
DescriptionEnhanced: This automaton designed in the likeness of Wuk Lamat was commissioned by a certain member of the royal family to commemorate the anniversary of her father's ascension. When the celebrations were delayed due to the rite of succession, however, the units were exported to Eorzea instead.
Tooltip:
There is no stopping the
Third Promise, is there?
   - Krile
SpecialActionDescription:
Doubles the amount of HP restored to allies stationed in Gates.
**Duration:** 20s

Description: Summon your wind-up köttr minion. Because you can never have too many bipedal felines.
DescriptionEnhanced: The catlike kettir are known for their mastery over wind magicks, but being as free-spirited as the winds they command, it can be a considerable trial to spur them to any sort of action. This being an automaton likeness, however, it should at least follow you obediently.
Tooltip:
I am but an innocent traveler with
a fondness for our feline friends.
   - Feline Fanatic
SpecialActionDescription:
Sets a trap that, when triggered, delivers an attack with a potency of 260 to all enemies within range.
**Activation Delay:** 10s

Description: Summon your wind-up Barret minion. There ain't no gettin' offa this train we on!
DescriptionEnhanced: Legends tell of a man who, driven by an unwavering sense of justice, led a resistance movement that sought to bring about lasting change in society. Despite being intimidating in appearance, he also possessed a kind-hearted side, and cherished his homeland and daughter above all else.
Tooltip:
Watch the barrel, dodge the bullet.
   - Hardiboiled

Description: Summon your Nymian uolosapa minion. A winsome bird with cinnamon markings on a canvas of white.
DescriptionEnhanced: In ages past, the uolosapa was brought from the south sea isles to the nation of Nym, where it quickly gained popularity as a pet. During this time, an unusual specimen with light-brown markings arrived on a merchant vessel from Meracydia, and it became established as a distinct breed.
SpecialActionDescription:
Increases ATK of all allies within range by 25.
 **Duration:** 6s

Description: Summon your sweetkit minion. Smells as sweet as it looks.
Summon your lolly cat minion. Smells as sweet as it looks.
DescriptionEnhanced: This stray kitten once prowled the Studium's grounds until an experimental sweetener, surreptitiously eaten, turned the markings on its coat a distinctive pink, and it began giving off a sweet scent. Feeling responsible for its state, the researcher put out a call for adoption in academic journals.
